# Title: Theory of Equivalence
## 1.0: Proposition

Building upon the foundations laid by "no system is self-sufficient", this theory aims to develop a unifying model of meaning and material, as necessary.

## 2.0: Model
The following 

Essence, Function, Form, Affect.

## 3.0: Truth, Meaning and Reality
Can Truth, Meaning and Reality intersect? Infact, the fundamental model

The material world, as described by Atheists, is one of "blind, pitiless indifference"[^1]. The problem is expressed by this theory; we are not examining the origins or intellligent-design of the universe; but the everyday implications of such belief systems. Again **we are not affected by the system, but by it's internal and external, implicit or explicit affects.**



[^1]: In this case, a famous quote by Richard Dawkins
